ExplorerBlurMica 2.1.0
======================

The file ExplorerBlurMica.dll in this folder is ExplorerBlurMica by Maplespe, unmodified, exactly as
published in the official Release_x64.zip of version 2.1.0.

  Project and source code:  https://github.com/Maplespe/ExplorerBlurMica
  License:                  GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 (LGPL-3.0)
  SHA-256 of the DLL:       36b44444fc8ae1c4fdc3a80cdc6b0c0a04cc843984189c17dadf964bcaa9f052

The full LGPL-3.0 text is in LICENSE-LGPL-3.0.txt in this folder. It adds permissions to the GNU General
Public License, version 3, whose text is LICENSE.txt in the Open Fluid Glass folder.

It clears the background of the File Explorer content area (navigation pane and file list) so the glass
behind the window shows through, which Open Fluid Glass then turns into Fluid Glass. Open Fluid Glass loads it as
a separate library (a shell extension registered by the installer) and does not link it into any of its
own programs. You may replace ExplorerBlurMica.dll with your own build of the same source: stop
Explorer, copy the file over, and start Explorer again.

ReadMe.txt in this folder is the author's own readme for this version.
